subject.title: Feature: allow account switching from /models buttons for GPT and Claude

question: Should OpenClaw add first-class account/profile selection to the `/models` picker, or keep account switching as typed `/model ...@<profileId>` plus CLI/status flows?
rationale: The request adds cross-surface auth-routing UX across mature provider, session, Discord, and Telegram picker paths, and repository policy treats provider/auth/session routing as compatibility-sensitive product surface.

options.title: Sponsor account picker UX
options.body: Add a shared account/profile picker contract that reuses `authProfileOverride`, shows the active profile, and keeps Discord, Telegram, text/status, and Gateway behavior consistent.

options.title: Keep typed profile switching only
options.body: Leave account switching in `/model ...@<profileId>` and auth CLI/status flows, and close or defer picker UI work to avoid expanding auth routing surface.

options.title: Narrow to preservation bug first
options.body: Land or close the related preservation PR separately, then revisit direct account selection once the current profile-preservation behavior is settled.

recommendation.title: Sponsor account picker UX
recommendation.body: Add a shared account/profile picker contract that reuses `authProfileOverride`, shows the active profile, and keeps Discord, Telegram, text/status, and Gateway behavior consistent.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent shared picker and Discord picker history makes this the best available routing candidate for the product-boundary decision.
